answer_1.quote: Our goal is to learn a probabilistic model p(R|C, K, P) that could generate a personalized and informative response based on personal memory and knowledge.

answer_2.quote: We choose distinctness, BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR to be our automatic metrics. ... we also evaluate Recall@1, Recall@2, Recall@5, Recall@10 for knowledge selection.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, 200 examples are randomly sampled from the test set and well-educated native speakers are recruited to assess the quality of the generation from different models with their source hidden.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator gives a score in {0: bad, 1: fair, 2: good} for three aspects: fluency, coherence, and faithfulness.
